commits.message:
Import the text of Word 6.0/95 files; text-only fallback under recover

Word 6.0 and Word 95 files (wIdent 0xA5DC, nFib 101-105) were refused
outright. extractLegacyWordText now reads their main text: 8-bit text at
fcMin, or through the piece table that fast-saved files keep in the
WordDocument stream, decoded as Windows-1252 or (chse 256) Mac Roman.
Encrypted files stay refused.

convertLegacyWord(recover: true) falls back to a text-only DOCX for any
file whose structure cannot be converted but whose text can be read
(Word 6/95, or Word 97+ structure that contradicts itself), marked with
recoveredTextOnly and every limitation.

Local corpus: the one Word 6 file (Word for Mac refuses to open it)
converts; its text equals LibreOffice's conversion exactly (54/54
paragraphs). The one Word 97 file still refused over bookmarks, fields
and revisions now yields its text (623k characters).
